body.name: Quantitative Gumbel-scale nuisance and primitive threshold
body.construction: The condition \(\mathsf G_n\) is \(n^{5/6}(\log n)^{3/2}\mathfrak B_n=o_P(1)\), \(\sqrt{\log n}\,\mathfrak R_n=o_P(1)\), \((\log n)\mathfrak K_n=o_P(1)\), and \(|\widehat{\mathcal V}_n/\mathcal V(P)-1|=o_P(1)\), each uniformly over \(P\in\mathcal M\). The first display is the product-bias threshold, the second is the centered local empirical perturbation threshold on intervals of width at most \(H_n\), the third controls variance normalization at an LR excursion of order \(\log n\), and the fourth controls Gumbel centering through the spatial clock.
